system.description: After you roll a Check, spend 1 Fabula Point to invoke your Bounty as an Instinct: that Check triggers a critical success if both dice show the same number, provided the Result is not a fumble. And damage dealt by your tools ignores Immunities and Resistances against your Bounty, as printed. Tools cost 2–4 IP and IP is finite, so this is realistically 3–5 tools a conflict — preparation pays, and against your Bounty it pays through.
